sprite: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: a single transparent 2D videogame animation sprite-sheet atlas, exactly FOUR columns and FIVE rows of equally sized cells, 20 complete separate full-body poses. Same original female gothic ninja in every cell: ash-grey hood, dark fitted layered leather armor, steel half-mask covering nose and mouth, silver forearm plates, two short hooked steel daggers, ragged charcoal cloak with restrained faded jade lining, boots. Haunted medieval cathedral atmosphere in the character design; no anime, no chibi, no modern military gear. Facing RIGHT in side three-quarter view, opponent is right. Painterly crisp high-contrast dark-fantasy game sprites, pale silver edge lighting to read against black. Row 1: four subtle breathing idle frames. Row 2: four attack frames, coiled anticipation, wide diagonal dagger slash, forward crossing slash, recovery; powerful deliberate cuts, weapons completely inside each cell. Row 3: four block/parry frames, blades crossed to stop a strike then return to guard, feet remain planted. Row 4: four power-casting frames raising one poison-tinged dagger, cloak moving, return to guard. Row 5: four death frames, stagger, one knee, falling, resting on ground. Within every cell same scale, consistent anatomy/equipment and foot baseline at 90% cell height; centered hips at 50% cell width in standing frames. Clear generous transparent gaps around every figure, no overlap between cells. Only character pixels; truly transparent background; no floor, cast shadows, smoke clouds, labels, grid lines, borders, writing, glyphs, logos, UI or cropped blades. 2048x2560 pixels if possible.
